FromFile.summary: Attempts to add the samples from the given file to the cache. Do not use this for storing lengthy audio, stream the files instead.
FromFile.returns:
A
if the clip was added to the cache. Null if the file doesn't exist, no factory was registered for the type, or no
was returned.

FromFiles.summary: Attempts to add the clips from the given files to the cache with keys based on files' names. Do not use this for storing lengthy audio, stream the files instead.

One.summary: Attempts to add the samples from the given embedded resource to the cache. Do not use this for storing lengthy audio, stream the resource instead.
One.param: The assembly to locate the resource in.
The name of the manifest resource.
The type of the file, used to resolve a reader factory.
If not null and the resource's duration is longer than this value, it will not be added to the cache.
Whether to trim the file extension from the name.
One.returns:
A
if the clip was added to the cache. Null if the resource doesn't exist or couldn't be opened, no factory was registered for the type, or no
was returned.

Multiple.param: The assembly to locate resources in.
If not null, resources with a different extension (based on the resource name) will be skipped.
If not null and a resource's duration is longer than this value, it will not be added to the cache.
Whether to trim the file extension from names.
Multiple.returns: The number of clips added to the cache.

NoTime.remarks: If an entry already exists, it will be overwritten. Audio is automatically converted to player-compatible samples.

Time.remarks: If an entry already exists, it will be overwritten. Audio is automatically converted to player-compatible samples. Audio file duration may be an estimate for compressed files.
